# IncubXperts

> IncubXperts is an AI-native engineering and software partner. We help enterprises adopt AI with purpose-built strategy, build agentic solutions, automate workflows, and modernize cloud infrastructure. Founded in India, with offices in Pune, India (HQ) and Delaware, USA. 150+ experts, 95% client retention rate, 55% CAGR since 2021.

## Company

- Legal name: IncubXperts TechnoConsulting Pvt. Ltd. (India) / IncubXperts Inc. (USA, Delaware)
- Founded: as a private limited organization in India; incorporated in Delaware, USA in 2020
- Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Secondary registered entity: Wilmington, Delaware, USA.
- Employees: 150+
- Leadership: Anish Betawadkar (Co-Founder & Director), Dr. Preetam Tiwari (Co-Founder & Director), Rahul Bagal (Co-Founder & Director), Amit Dhandal (Co-Founder & Director)
- Contact: engage@incubxperts.com (business), careers@incubxperts.com (careers)

## Services

- **AI Adoption & Strategy**: Purpose-built AI adoption strategy — feasibility assessment, high-impact opportunity identification, adoption roadmaps, pilot design and scaling, TCO optimization, governance and compliance.
- **Agentic Solutions**: Autonomous AI agents that think, decide, and act on real-world tasks.
- **Workflow Automation**: AI-driven automation of business workflows.
- **AI-Augmented Product Engineering**: Software product engineering augmented by AI tooling with human-led precision.
- **AI-Augmented QA**: AI-assisted software testing and validation.
- **Predictive Analytics & BI**: Turning data into actionable business intelligence.
- **MVP in 10 Days**: Rapid AI-accelerated MVP development.
- **Cloud & AI Infrastructure**: Cloud infrastructure design for AI workloads, including AI-first architecture and governance.
- **Global Capacity Center (GCC)**: Dedicated global capacity center services for SMB and mid-market companies.

## Industries Served

Fintech, Healthcare, Public Safety, Social Networking, Hospitality, Legal, Manufacturing, Environment & Sustainability.

## Technology Stack

AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, Meta open-source LLMs, Claude (Anthropic), Dynamics 365 CRM, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps.

- [AI-Driven, IoT-Enabled Solution for a Leading Kitchenware Brand](/case-studies/ai-driven-iot-enabled-solution-for-a-leading-kitchenware-brand.html): How IncubXperts built a cross-platform app for IoT-enabled smart tiffins and water bottles, with voice control, geofencing, and AI hydration tracking.
- [AI-Driven Gamified Platform: Cultivating Grit in Youth](/case-studies/ai-driven-gamified-platform-cultivating-grit-in-youth.html): How IncubXperts built an AI-powered, multi-tenant gamified mobile platform for educational institutions, cutting infrastructure cost by 60%.
- [A Serverless MVP Resulting In Greater Capex Savings](/case-studies/a-serverless-mvp-resulting-in-greater-capex-savings.html): How IncubXperts built a fully serverless MVP on AWS to digitize the US medical recall process for pharmaceuticals and devices, cutting infrastructure cost.
- [A SaaS Platform for Efficient Mutual Fund Investment and Management](/case-studies/a-saas-platform-for-efficient-mutual-fund-investment-and-management.html): How IncubXperts built a scalable B2C Progressive Web App for a fintech startup, enabling automated mutual fund investments, SIP creation, and KYC.
